metadata.study: paired low-cache-hit Cache-only versus UAV-only offline counterfactual
metadata.policy_evaluation: deterministic torch.inference_mode frozen inference; no optimizer step and no checkpoint write
metadata.matching_candidate_method: production execute_configured_slot; fresh formal Matching + shared Cloud KKT/CPU allocation for each candidate and replay Slot
metadata.bootstrap_method: percentile bootstrap of the mean with 4000 resamples and fixed per-summary seeds

definitions.primary_cache_hit_rate: For each actual task in a macro Cache-decision state, count a hit if its requested service exists in at least one SV/RSU/UAV edge cache; divide by actual task count. This is service availability and is not the selected execution-node hit rate.
definitions.selected_edge_cache_hit_rate: Tasks matched to an edge node whose selected node stores the requested service, divided by all actual tasks; the conditional-on-edge rate is also reported.
definitions.cache_hit_metric_source: RECOMPUTED_FROM_FROZEN_REPLAY; Run slot logs do not contain request hit fields
definitions.feasible_edge_path_rate: Tasks with at least one cached edge target accepted by the production path/role/rate feasibility check, divided by actual task count.
definitions.low_hit_threshold: Empirical 25th percentile of primary request-any-edge hit rates across valid macro Cache-decision states (at least one task) in the eight saved Training realizations; preliminary sample threshold, not a general optimum.
definitions.threshold_state_timing: Hit rate is computed from the pre-action Cache at a legal Macro decision boundary, before the current Cache proposal is applied.
definitions.baseline: The frozen policy's actual deterministic Cache and UAV actions at the decision state; KEEP+STAY is retained as a reference.
definitions.cache_only_candidate_scope: Frozen-policy Cache action plus every legal single-node UPDATE proposal, with frozen-policy UAV positions fixed; no multi-node combination.
definitions.uav_only_candidate_scope: Frozen-policy UAV action, all-UAV STAY and legal single-head proposals, with Cache fixed to frozen-policy Cache; no multi-UAV combination.
definitions.oracle_boundary: Actual current tasks rank candidate G; policy observations use forecasts and configuration, not actual_tasks. Candidate maxima are offline oracle upper bounds within the enumerated subsets.
definitions.ten_slot_pairing: All branches start from the same pre-action cache/UAV snapshot and replay the same saved aligned Training steps; after the first intervention, the deterministic frozen policy resumes and states evolve through the official Slot executor.
definitions.task_energy: Vehicle upload/transmission energy from the formal per-task vehicle-energy outputs.
definitions.service_activation: Formal current behavior applies candidate cache state immediately; download is charged as a reward reconfiguration penalty only. No transfer queue or across-slot download completion is simulated.

state_distribution.threshold_method: empirical P25 over valid Macro Cache-decision states with actual tasks; fixed before candidate evaluation

low_hit_trigger_assessment.decision_rule: SUPPORTED only when n>=5, low-group oracle mean 95% CI is above zero, and matched low-minus-control oracle gain 95% CI is above zero, unless the control group also has >=80% positive gains and a positive lower 95% CI (then INCONCLUSIVE as a sufficient low-hit trigger); NOT_SUPPORTED when the contrast upper CI is at/below zero; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE.

limitations: The checkpoint is an early Alternating V1 model after 8 Episodes and 2 Policy Updates; results are not evidence about a converged/final policy.
The frozen policy was replayed on the same eight Training realizations used before this checkpoint, so this is an in-sample Training diagnostic.
Only single-node Cache updates and one-UAV-at-a-time moves were enumerated; no joint Cache+UAV actions, multi-node updates, or simultaneous multi-UAV combinations were tested.
Oracle ranking uses realized current tasks, absent from actor observation; best scores are offline counterfactual upper bounds only within the enumerated subsets.

The current actor's deterministic forecast-driven actions are measured separately against KEEP/STAY references; there is no low-hit-conditioned trigger or prediction-based candidate-value selector in the formal algorithm.
The study uses macro Cache-decision boundary states so Cache interventions respect Adaptive Holding; it does not include intermediate held slots as Cache action opportunities.
Ten-Slot replay is limited to the representative matched pairs reported and is exploratory rather than a population estimate.
Formal service activation remains immediate after an UPDATE and does not simulate an actual download queue or cross-slot completion process.

task_level_attribution.scope: All 2400 saved Training Slots replayed with the Run's latest valid Checkpoint; not a reconstruction of stochastic per-task assignments made during the original training episodes.

category_definitions.A_SERVICE_NOT_CACHED: Request service is absent from all edge caches active at execution; selected Cloud.
category_definitions.B_CACHED_EDGE_INFEASIBLE: Request service is cached somewhere, but the production feasible-target builder returns no legal/reachable Edge path; selected Cloud.
category_definitions.C_CACHED_EDGE_FEASIBLE_CLOUD_SELECTED: Request service is cached and at least one production Edge target passes path/role/rate feasibility; selected Cloud after full Matching+KKT.
category_definitions.D_CACHED_EDGE_EXECUTED: Matching selects an Edge node that has the request service cached and is in the production feasible Edge target list.

cached_and_edge_feasible_but_cloud_selec.matching_history_limit: Production Matching logs accepted transfer/exchange operations, not every candidate's task-level score; current original Run slot logs contain no per-task targets or scores.

edge_vs_cloud_counterfactual.method: Representative C tasks selected deterministically as the first C task by (Episode, Slot, task_id), at most one per Episode; force that task to the first feasible Edge node in the formal node order, keep same Slot tasks/vehicle positions/active Cache/UAV, and rerun production Matching+KKT with all other tasks mutable.

prediction_and_cache_value_readiness.predicted_cache_marginal_value_status: PROXY_ESTIMABLE; calibrated future net system utility is not directly provided by the actor candidate score and requires same-window forecast Matching evaluations.
prediction_and_cache_value_readiness.future_eviction_opportunity_cost_status: FORECAST_DEMAND_PROXY_AVAILABLE; no direct calibrated system-utility opportunity-cost scalar is logged per candidate.

current_run_macro_actor_advantage_mode: formal Macro SMDP GAE; joint Cache and sampled termination PPO
current_trigger_credit_reassessment.actor_action_semantics: Each factorized Cache node head selects KEEP (candidate 0) or one legal UPDATE target (candidate >0); trigger and candidate are values of the same categorical decision, not separately scored modules.
current_trigger_credit_reassessment.current_macro_training_credit: The joint Macro Actor uses the configured formal Macro SMDP GAE / clipped PPO objective for Cache candidates and sampled termination decisions.
current_trigger_credit_reassessment.trigger_candidate_comparison_consistency: SHARED_RETURN_CREDIT; no separately logged predicted net-value comparator for KEEP versus each UPDATE target.
current_trigger_credit_reassessment.historical_cache_trigger_causal_gate_sco: The existing cache_trigger_causal_gate.md report analyzes different stage2d LR checkpoints; it is not evidence about this controlled Run's latest Checkpoint.
current_trigger_credit_reassessment.evidence_limit: Only two Policy Updates are present; this establishes the code/checkpoint credit contract, not learned trigger calibration or convergence.
